question: ¿En cuántos ensayos activos (reclutando, activos sin reclutar, todavía sin reclutar o por invitación) se está probando pembrolizumab?

attempts.query:
SELECT count(DISTINCT s.nct_id)
FROM aact.studies s
WHERE s.overall_status IN ('RECRUITING','ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING','NOT_YET_RECRUITING','ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION')
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.interventions i WHERE i.nct_id = s.nct_id AND (i.name ILIKE '%pembrolizumab%' OR i.name ILIKE '%keytruda%' OR i.name ILIKE '%mk-3475%' OR i.name ILIKE '%mk3475%'))
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.intervention_other_names o WHERE o.nct_id = s.nct_id AND (o.name ILIKE '%pembrolizumab%' OR o.name ILIKE '%keytruda%' OR o.name ILIKE '%mk-3475%' OR o.name ILIKE '%mk3475%')))
